verdict.rationale: Gram is a hosted MCP server and gateway platform, so event triggers or webhooks from connected downstream apps are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack does not document any trigger, webhook or event-subscription mechanism that lets an agent receive downstream events instead of polling. The only nearby items are tool-call execution logs and 'configure telemetry delivery', which are observability features, not inbound event subscriptions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them
